title: RawQuirkKey
description: The raw quirk key (spec section 2.4.1 rule 6): which quirks the emitters realised, in which file and row, with the intended instant, and which entry errors the transcription step typed. Hidden: the assembly writes it from the emitters' plain-data output and only the evaluator reads it; the parser and the recorders never do. One key per (scenario, seed, architecture) because the capture path and the belief of an adapter can differ per architecture.

replay_of.description: The file this one repeats byte for byte (a transfer retry, RQ4), else null.

line.description: Physical line of the file, banner included.

intended_s.description: The instant the row stands for, in seconds of the scenario, before any truncation to the resolution of the dialect.

ambiguous.description: The stamp text can be read validly in more than one way under the format the device writes (RQ2).

repeat.description: The row is a second or later copy of a row written before, in this file or an earlier one (append mode, overlapping export, replayed file; RQ4).

unreadable.description: The row was written so that no parser can read it (a deliberately broken line).

entry_errors.description: Manual transcription only: the results a person typed wrongly.

opportunities.description: The common draws, identical on both capture paths: purpose raw:<quirk id> or error:<type>, the id the draw is keyed by, and u in [0, 1).

not_modelled.description: Classes with no ledger rate that a production run reports as not modelled and never gives a number.
